query:
SELECT 
  p.id, p.name, p.isComposite,
  pc.childProductId, pc.quantity,
  cp.name as componentName
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN productCompositions pc ON p.id = pc.productId
LEFT JOIN products cp ON pc.childProductId = cp.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Dose%' OR p.name LIKE '%Dober%'
ORDER BY p.id;
